name: Postaxial Polydactyly Type B

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Postaxial Polydactyly Type B

criteria.description: Presence of a rudimentary, pedunculated extra digit on the ulnar side of the hand or fibular side of the foot
Extra digit composed primarily of soft tissue without well-formed bones
Positive family history of postaxial polydactyly type B or related limb malformations
Radiographs showing absence of fully developed phalanges in the extra digit

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a pedunculated rudimentary extra digit on the postaxial side with absence of bony structures in the extra digit
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; genetic testing may assist but is not routinely required.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically located on the ulnar side of the hand or fibular side of the foot
